purpose: Reusable, parameter-driven animation MODULES (not hardcoded scenes). Each module declares its inputs, the evidence that gates it, and what it may/may not do. A parameter changes the animation ONLY where the frozen package supports that relationship; otherwise the module is display-only or emits a HYPOTHESIZED info note.
design_principles: Data-driven: modules read preset + parameter values from data/profile-b-simulator-presets.json; no per-preset hardcoding.
Evidence-gated: each module has an evidence_gate; if the gate is not met the module renders display-only or a labelled info note.
Composable: a scene is a sequence of module instances bound to a preset's stage-applicability matrix.
Deterministic-timing forbidden unless a value exists: qualitative modules use eased, unlabelled motion.

modules.behavior: selects the administration sub-scene by route: topical (skin surface) for B1; systemic (contextual) for B2; none for B3 (comparator panel).
modules.may_not: imply an injection/IV journey for a topical preset

modules.evidence_gate: Chen 2012 skin permeation + depth sections 0-30/30-60/60-90 um
modules.behavior: animates particle/released-drug progression across three labelled skin depth bands (qualitative front); band labels = measured section boundaries.
modules.may_not: show blood-vessel extravasation or ECM traversal (DO_NOT_ANIMATE); assign a per-depth concentration not in the package

modules.evidence_gate: Chen 2012 uptake order cationic > neutral > anionic (HaCaT/B16BL6)
modules.behavior: maps the selected charge to a RELATIVE uptake-intensity visual (ordinal ranking only, not a rate).
modules.mandatory_info_note: confound: charge co-varies with lipid identity in Chen 2012; ranking is an observed association, not an isolated charge effect
modules.may_not: produce a numeric uptake rate or a size-driven change

modules.evidence_gate: sizes 84.5-90.2 nm reported (too close to differentiate outcomes)
modules.may_not: drive a penetration-depth or uptake change from size (no supporting evidence; would be invented)

modules.evidence_gate: B1: first-order selected + delayed release (qualitative); B2/B3: release NOT REPORTED
modules.behavior: B1 -> qualitative sustained/delayed-release visual (particles gradually emitting drug), NO plotted curve; B2/B3 -> release module DISABLED.
modules.mandatory_info_note: Sustained/delayed release reported; exact release kinetics were not available (Chen 2012 selected a first-order model).
modules.may_not: draw a specific release curve or state a release time/percentage not in the package

modules.evidence_gate: Wang 2025 abstract: ER localization -> ER stress -> CRT/HMGB1/ATP -> DC maturation -> CD8+ activation
modules.behavior: qualitative mechanism chain (abstract-supported); each node labelled 'abstract-supported'.
modules.may_not: attach numeric labels, sliders, or deterministic timing; imply a measured release curve

modules.evidence_gate: B1: reduced tumor burden (antimelanoma efficacy, cationic highest); B2: antitumor/anti-metastasis via ICD (abstract)
modules.behavior: qualitative reduction-of-tumor-cell visual for B1 (endpoint-supported); immune-activation visual for B2 (abstract).
modules.may_not: quantify tumor shrinkage %, survival, or dose-response not in the package

modules.evidence_gate: Shukla 2020: 30-fold solubility increase (SBE-betaCD), stability up in PBS pH7.4 + rat/human plasma, improved intestinal permeability, BCS IV
modules.behavior: static comparator INFO panel (bar/badge), not a body animation.
modules.may_not: animate precipitation/aggregation timing or nanoparticle growth (it is a molecular complex)

modules.evidence_gate: NONE in the Profile-B package for PK/circulation effects
modules.behavior: emits a HYPOTHESIZED / greyed info note instead of an animation. Example: PEG->longer circulation is a general nanomedicine expectation with NO Profile-B PK evidence.
modules.may_not: animate 'PEG = longer circulation', 'positive charge = more uptake as a rate', or size-dependent penetration as if quantified

modules.behavior: blocks precipitation, aggregation, degradation-onset, metabolic conversion, extravasation, ECM traversal from rendering as timed events; may show only a text risk note where the package allows a qualitative statement.
modules.may_not: render any of the blocked events as a deterministic animation

parameter_to_animation_map.coating_PEG: mod_hypothesized_property (info note only; no circulation animation)
parameter_to_animation_map.target_organ_disease: selects anatomical scene by preset (B1 skin/melanoma; B2 tumor/lung-met; B3 intestinal model)
